title: OSU's Styles wows with 43.5-inch combine vertical

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: OSU's Styles wows with 43.5-inch combine vertical
sources.description: Projected top-10 pick Sonny Styles posted the best vertical jump by an off-ball linebacker at the combine since 2003 and also dazzled with a 4.46 time in the 40-yard dash and an 11-foot-2-inch broad jump Thursday.
